environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or request filtering. ALB access logs enabled but sent to S3 only (no real-time alerting). The Flask app runs directly via gunicorn with 4 workers, no reverse proxy filtering layer.

config.alb_rules: default forward action only, no AWS managed rule groups attached
config.db: local SQLite at /var/data/app.db with rw permissions for app user
